incident_2026-09-02_incomplete_publish.what_happened: The original publish copied only index.html into this directory. index.html references two things via document-relative paths that only resolve correctly if the right sibling files exist next to it: a <script src="three.min.js"> tag, and assets/sfx/** for every audio sample (AudioRuntime.sampleBaseUrl = "assets/sfx/"). Neither three.min.js nor assets/ was copied, so three.min.js 404'd on the real public deployment.
incident_2026-09-02_incomplete_publish.observed_effect: The owner reached the title screen (plain DOM/CSS, does not need Three.js) but clicking New Game did nothing -- the title screen appeared frozen. Live reproduction against the actual public URL (not localhost) with real console/network monitoring captured the exact cause: an uncaught 'ReferenceError: THREE is not defined' at script parse/execution time, which halted ALL subsequent script execution in the page -- including the code that flips ready=true and playBtn.disabled=false at the end of the boot sequence, and the code that installs window.__t4Expose. The 3D scene never rendered (title-screen background was flat black instead of the live world visible behind the menu locally) -- consistent visual confirmation.
incident_2026-09-02_incomplete_publish.why_localhost_testing_missed_it: This session's entire pre-delivery verification (including the boot/playing screenshots used as launch/render evidence for the green-light banner) ran against localhost dev-serve ports, which serve the ZSS repository's real directory tree -- three.min.js and assets/ already sit correctly next to zombie-survivors.html there, so the identical relative-path references resolved fine. The Arcade candidate's nested directory structure was never actually exercised end-to-end through a real browser hitting the real public URL before the green-light banner was issued. That gap is now the recorded lesson, not just this one bug.
incident_2026-09-02_incomplete_publish.fix_applied: Copied three.min.js (sha256 7ae04663bb431808bc025280122162029ea3a354efc5fcca8bd8f95d1a1933e9, byte-identical to the ZSS repo source) and the full assets/ directory (22MB, 316 files, spot-checked byte-identical) into this same candidate directory, alongside the untouched, unmodified index.html. index.html's own bytes and candidate_sha256 above are completely unchanged -- this is a same-directory dependency completion, not a new candidate, since the artifact's own identity was never wrong, only incomplete alongside it.
incident_2026-09-02_incomplete_publish.verification_after_fix: See docs/agent-runs/2026-08-31-ten-honest-minutes/public-launch-failure/ in the ZSS repository for the full live re-verification: fresh/cache-busted public URL, title screen, a real CDP click on New Game, and confirmed populated gameplay with movement and combat sustained for 60+ seconds.
